target_customer: Food brands, grocers and retailers with perishable inventory
problem: Retailers and food brands waste product and lose sales through poor inventory forecasting, especially for fresh goods with short shelf life.
business_model: B2B SaaS for demand sensing, pricing and replenishment planning
product_category: AI demand forecasting and inventory planning

founders.name: Niki Khokale
founders.background_notes: Head of S&OP at Google, per the YC page.

founders.name: Rajas Lonkar
founders.background_notes: Product management and quant research at Google, advanced analytics at IBM.

technical_complexity.rationale: Forecasting demand across sales history, seasonality, holidays and price changes is standard applied ML but needs retailer data integration and accuracy proof.

defensibility.rationale: Forecast accuracy and integrations help, but large planning vendors and other startups offered similar forecasting, and models were reproducible.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Planning vendors kept competing. Fountain9 ended with an asset and team purchase by Rappi in 2024, not a full company deal.

market_need_then: The company's own pitch cited food waste and stockouts as costly; no independent 2021 spend data was found.

branding.domain_note: Used fountain9.com; the domain now redirects to kronoscope.ai.

rebrands.why: not stated in sources found; date unknown

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself was found; searches for the name returned unrelated Fountain brands, and the company later moved to the Kronoscope name.

outcome_analysis: Fountain9 raised a $1.9M seed in July 2021 after YC W21 and sold its IP and team assets to Rappi, reported around September 2024, to support TURBO retailing and a B2B supply chain offering. The price is not public. A three year gap with no sourced follow-on round suggests the company did not raise a larger round, but that is inference, so no failure factors are assigned.
notes: Seed confirmed by YourStory plus Devdiscourse and Seedtable. Aggregator totals conflict (Inc42 $3.8M across 2 rounds, CB Insights $2.03M across 4); not recorded as rounds. Persana blog claims a 2022 acquisition; 2024 used. No dated 2021 competitor source found, only current aggregator lists, so the competitor list is empty; RELEX, o9 Solutions, Shelf Engine and Afresh are later or undated listings.
